rows.note: This is the all-purpose Cantonese noun for the dish and for one pizza.

example.english: We ordered a pizza for delivery.
example.traditional: 我哋叫咗一個披薩外賣。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 giu3 zo2 jat1 go3 pei1 saat3 ngoi6 maai6

rows.note: Use this Chinese term especially when the thin-crust pizza meaning is clear, such as on menus; it can otherwise also mean a thin pancake.

example.english: The pizza on the menu has a thin, crispy crust.
example.traditional: 餐牌上面嗰款薄餅係薄脆底㗎。
example.jyutping: caan1 paai4 soeng6 min6 go2 fun2 bok6 beng2 hai6 bok6 ceoi3 dai2 gaa3
